meta.warning: Fees, SLAs and jurisdictions are indicative. Verify against each authority before go-live.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Mainland and freehold plots outside special development zones (Jumeirah, Umm Suqeim, Al Barsha, Mirdif, Al Safa, Nad Al Sheba etc.)
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Building permit, Modification / renovation permit, Demolition permit, Building Completion Certificate (BCC), Waste transfer
authorities.submission_channel: DM Building Permit System / Invest in Dubai portal (via licensed consultant)
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Structural modification requires a licensed consultant and structural assessment. Consultant is the submitting party - system must record consultant as agent.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: TECOM zones: Dubai Internet City, Media City, Knowledge Park, Barsha Heights, Dubai Design District, Production City, Studio City, Science Park, International Academic City, Al Barsha South
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out permit, Building modification permit, Completion certificate, Signage permit
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Fit-out permits usually issued to a DDA-registered contractor. Contractor registration renewal is annual - track as a company-level compliance item.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Islands / Park / Heights, Discovery Gardens, International City, Jebel Ali, Dubai Waterfront, Nakheel master developments, Dragon Mart
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Building modification / fit-out permit, EHS approval, NOC, Completion certificate
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Trakhees requires contractor registration and classification. Do not allow award to a subcontractor without valid Trakhees registration - hard gate.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out permit, Work permit, Completion / handover approval
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Building management NOC usually required in parallel with authority permit.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out permit, Building modification, Completion certificate
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Strict working-hours and noise rules in occupied towers - map to calendar constraints.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out permit, Modification permit, Completion
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Separate approvals for civil, electrical and mechanical scopes.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Dubai South districts, Expo City vicinity
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out permit, Building permit, Completion
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Aviation-district height and access restrictions may apply.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fit-out / modification permit, Completion
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Industrial units - additional EHS approvals.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: All of Dubai - fire and life safety
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fire and life safety design NOC, Modification NOC, Final inspection / completion NOC
authorities.submission_channel: DCD e-services via approved consultant / contractor
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Any change to sprinklers, detection, fire-rated construction, gas or emergency lighting triggers a DCD NOC. Fire contractors must hold DCD approval - hard gate on subcontractor award.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Temporary supply, Load increase / meter application, Disconnection and reconnection, NOC for excavation or demolition, Solar (Shams Dubai) connection
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Electrical contractor must be DEWA-enrolled. Disconnection before demolition and reconnection before handover are separate cases - both must appear on the programme.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Public roads, right of way, metro corridors
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Hoarding on right of way, Road opening, Crane and lifting permit, Heavy vehicle movement, NOC near metro
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Villa projects usually need this only for skips, hoarding or crane lifts on the road. Trigger by scope toggle.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: CCTV and access control design approval, Installation NOC, Final inspection
authorities.notes_for_configuration: CCTV / access control installer must hold a SIRA licence - hard gate on subcontractor award.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Construction and demolition waste transfer permit, Tipping tickets
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Tipping receipts are often required as evidence to release community deposits - store against the deposit refund case.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Kitchen layout approval, Food establishment permit
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Triggered only when the project scope includes a commercial kitchen.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Signage / fascia permit, Trade licence activity
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Retail and office fit-out - external signage is a separate permit.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Healthcare facility layout approval, Licensing inspection
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Clinic fit-out only.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Educational facility approval
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Nursery and school fit-out only.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Arabian Ranches 1-3, Dubai Hills Estate, Emirates Living (Springs, Meadows, Lakes), The Greens and Views, Downtown, Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar Beachfront, Emaar South
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Works permit, Contractor registration, Access cards
authorities.submission_channel: Emaar / LOAMS community portal or e-mail submission
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Refundable security deposit and a works permit with a fixed validity window. Working-hours and Friday / public-holiday restrictions must map to the project calendar.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Park, Jumeirah Islands, Jumeirah Heights, Al Furjan, The Gardens, Nad Al Sheba, Warsan
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Modification approval, Contractor registration, Access and gate passes
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Usually runs in parallel with Trakhees - configure as a dependent pair.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: City Walk, La Mer, Bluewaters, Port de La Mer, Jumeirah Bay, Madinat Jumeirah Living
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Fit-out permit, Access approval
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Tight delivery and access windows in mixed-use districts.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: DAMAC Hills 1 and 2, AKOYA, DAMAC Lagoons
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Works permit, Contractor registration
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Deposit refund tied to common-area condition sign-off.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Works permit
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Landscape and facade change restrictions are strict.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Mudon, Villanova, Serena, Remraam, JBR, Business Bay, Wasl communities
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Fit-out approval
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Several communities are managed by third-party OA companies - keep OA as a separate linked record.

authorities.authority__body: Tilal Al Ghaf / Majid Al Futtaim
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Works permit
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Design review of any external change.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Design approval

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Apartment towers and mixed-use buildings (LOAMS, Kaizen, Deyaar FM, Farnek, Concordia, Idama, Savills and similar)

authorities.notes_for_configuration: Create one record per managed building. Lift booking and material movement windows are scheduling constraints - push to the programme.

authorities.authority__body: Abu Dhabi - DMT / Abu Dhabi City Municipality
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Building permit, Fit-out / modification permit, Completion certificate, Estidama Pearl compliance
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Estidama Pearl rating requirements apply to many project types.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Temporary supply, Meter, Disconnection and reconnection
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Mirror of the DEWA workflow.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Fire and life safety NOC, Final inspection
authorities.notes_for_configuration: UAE Fire and Life Safety Code applies.

authorities.jurisdiction__areas_covered: Yas Island, Al Raha, Reem Island, Saadiyat, Noya, Alreeman
authorities.permits_issued_typical: Community NOC, Fit-out permit, Contractor registration
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Mall units (for example Yas Mall) follow a separate retail-delivery fit-out manual with night-work windows.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Building permit, Modification permit, Completion
authorities.notes_for_configuration: Different fee structure and approval flow to Dubai.

authorities.permits_issued_typical: Supply, meter, disconnection and reconnection

sc_portal_features.feature: Self-service company registration and profile with document upload
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Removes the e-mail and WhatsApp document chase entirely

sc_portal_features.feature: Subcontractor invites and manages its own team members with role permissions
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: One account per company, not per person - the portal scales without your admin effort

sc_portal_features.feature: Worker roster with visa, Emirates ID, insurance and trade certificate expiry
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: A worker with an expired document is automatically blocked from the site register

sc_portal_features.feature: RFQ inbox with drawings, specification, site visit slot and deadline countdown
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Every bidder receives an identical package - eliminates the disputed scope argument

sc_portal_features.feature: Rate entry directly into your BOQ template, or Excel upload with column mapping
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Comparison becomes automatic because everyone quotes on the same structure

sc_portal_features.feature: Tender clarification thread with addenda broadcast to all bidders
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: One answer reaches every bidder - protects tender integrity and your audit trail

sc_portal_features.feature: Sealed bids until the deadline, then side-by-side normalised comparison
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Prevents rate leakage and gives you a defensible award recommendation

sc_portal_features.feature: Automatic eligibility gating on licence, insurance and community registration
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: A subcontractor without Civil Defence or SIRA approval cannot be awarded that package

sc_portal_features.feature: Award pack: scope, priced BOQ, drawings revision, programme extract, site rules
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: The subcontractor receives everything in one issue with a single acknowledgement

sc_portal_features.feature: Digital subcontract agreement with e-signature
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Removes the two week contract signing delay

sc_portal_features.feature: Assigned programme activities pushed from the master Gantt
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: The subcontractor sees only their activities and their dates - no more paper programmes

sc_portal_features.feature: Daily manpower return and progress update from mobile, offline capable
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Your progress data arrives without a site engineer chasing it

sc_portal_features.feature: Material delivery request and free-issue material acknowledgement
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Ends the argument about what was supplied by whom

sc_portal_features.feature: Snag list filtered to that subcontractor with photo evidence and due dates
sc_portal_features.why_it_matters: Snag closure becomes measurable per trade instead of one shared list

sc_portal_features.feature: Inspection request submission with notice period and result tracking

sc_portal_features.feature: HSE: toolbox talks, permits to work, incident reporting, induction status

sc_portal_features.feature: Document submittals: method statements, material samples, shop drawings
